# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

1. CI run 38112524699 failed because "Core tests (shard 0/4)" failed on a flaky perf test: `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart: wrap time grows linearly: ASCII prose, 2x input <= 3.2x time` — ratio 3.65 vs 3.2 threshold. This test is from main (perf #1502), unrelated to the PR's usage changes.

2. The kicker then re-requested the 3 required contexts; the Quality gate/JS engine/Binaries legs in the kicker run failed instantly with no runner/steps — likely because the kicker's gh api invocation... Actually those legs in run 38111774140 were created at 05:06:10-12 with no steps and failure — possibly the kicker creating check runs via create_check_run or triggering a workflow that immediately failed. Regardless, the root cause of the red head is the flaky perf test.

What's the right fix for rework? The failing test is a perf-threshold test that flaked on a loaded CI runner (3.65 vs 3.2; other legs of the same test passed: CJK 2x<=3.2 passed, hard-cut passed). Options:

1. Re-run CI (no code change) — but the rework pack requires a code fix; also after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head. So pushing a new commit is required anyway.

2. Look at the test — maybe it's inherently flaky and the repo has a mechanism for perf test retries or quarantine (there's a "Flake quarantine list guard"). Check how similar flakes are handled. Maybe bump iterations/median or widen threshold. But careful: the test was recently added in #1502 (perf work). Changing the threshold could be considered gaming.

Let me look at the test first.

Root cause identified: CI shard 0/4 failed on `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — a timing flake (ratio 3.65 vs 3.2 threshold) from the freshly merged main perf change (#1502), unrelated to this PR's usage code. Let me examine the test.
{"path":"/home/runner/work/flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness/test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart"}

The flake: at 100k/200k cells, times are tiny (3.31ms / 12.09ms) — at these small sizes, timer jitter dominates: ratio of 3.65 when the true asymptotic ratio is ~2x. The CJK and single-word variants passed. The ASCII prose path is the fastest (batched), so at 100k cells the measurement is only ~3.3ms — noise floor.

Fix options:
1. Increase base size for ASCII prose (e.g., 200k/400k) so measurements are well above the noise floor. Times were 3.31ms and 12.09ms — 12ms for doubled... wait if linear, doubling 100k→200k should be ~2x. 3.31→12.09 is 3.65x. Hmm, but the 1M test passes <100ms, so 100k should be ~10ms if linear... it measured 3.31ms at 100k and the 1M measured under 100ms — 1M/100k=10x → if linear, 1M ≈ 33ms, well under 100. So why 12.09ms for 200k? 200k should be ~6.6ms linear. 12.09 is nearly 2x that... hmm, maybe cache effects. Anyway, median of 5 runs still jittered.

Actually wait — is this test failing because of this PR? The PR didn't touch wrapAnsiLine. The merge brought #1502's perf change with this new test file. CI flake. But the rework instructions: "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". The root cause is a flaky perf threshold at small sample size on a loaded shared CI runner.

The right fix per the file's own doc: "Bounds follow the gh-1357 rule: absolute budgets carry generous headroom over local medians (CI runners jitter...)". The growth-shape asserts use median of 5 runs at 100k base. For the fastest path (ASCII batching), 3.3ms median is at the noise floor; CI runner jitter makes the ratio unreliable. The fix: raise the base cells for the growth tests so the timings are comfortably above jitter (e.g., 250k/500k → ~8ms/~16-30ms medians), keeping threshold 3.2.

TDD: reproduce locally? The failure is environment jitter; locally it may pass. I can demonstrate the noise sensitivity: run the test repeatedly, or simulate jitter. Better: write a test demonstrating that measurement noise dominates at the current size? That's hard deterministically. Alternative: run the perf test locally several times to see variance, then make the change and verify stability.

Let me first check if there's a flake quarantine mechanism and whether this test is already handled. Also check the "Flake quarantine list guard". Maybe there's an established pattern for perf test retries (e.g., `--tags perf` retry loops in CI). Look at ci.yml around line 2578: "Quality gate below. `--tags perf` is precise..." Let me check how perf tests run in CI — maybe they run with retries, and core shard runs them too.

          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.
  # This leg runs the same
  # perf-tagged tests for trajectory-touching PRs and aggregates into
  # Quality gate below. `--tags perf` is precise: the only perf-tagged test
  # is the #262 gate (test/integration/trajectory/perf_open_gate_test.dart,
  # lands with #300), so the 97 MB fixture never runs for other PRs.
  perf-gate:
    name: Perf gate (trajectory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.perf == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test --tags perf
        run: dart test --tags perf

  # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
  # `model_request_summary` records and the session chain's record shape —
  # a shape change there breaks the fold even when every regular leg is
  # green, so this suite is a merge gate for trajectory/session/usage
  # diffs. Gate model (2026-09 dispatch-only CI): this workflow has NO
  # pull_request trigger — the SM dispatches it on the PR head, so
  # `github.event_name` is never 'pull_request' and a PR-only `if` would
  # leave this leg permanently skipped (REG-1 gating nothing). On real PR
  # events the path classifier narrows it to usage-relevant diffs; on every
  # other event (main/tags/schedule/release + SM validation dispatches)
  # the full gate runs, so the suite runs there too. Same latent bug still
  # pending for perf-gate (issue #303) — flagged in the gh-1243 rework.
  usage-fold:
    name: Usage fold (ledger chain)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      needs.changes.outputs.usagefold == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Usage-fold suite
        # The path classifier also gates on ^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$
        # — the CLI wiring test that exercises that file must run here too,
        # otherwise a wiring regression merges behind a green test/usage.
        run: dart test test/usage test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0239549Z # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0240493Z # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0241382Z # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242221Z # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254067Z # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0256564Z #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0257384Z #     swapped in the first cut, re-enshrining the starvation);
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0258602Z #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0259401Z #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261101Z #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261930Z #     a red Windows build must not hold the pure-Dart publish
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0262882Z #     hostage (the v1.0.519-521 starvation).

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

Fix options:

Times were 3.31ms and 12.09ms — 12ms for doubled... wait if linear, doubling 100k→200k should be ~2x. 3.31→12.09 is 3.65x. The growth-shape asserts use median of 5 runs at 100k base. For the fastest path (ASCII batching), 3.3ms median is at the noise floor; CI runner jitter makes the ratio unreliable. The fix: raise the base cells for the growth tests so the timings are comfortably above jitter (e.g., 250k/500k → ~8ms/~16-30ms medians), keeping threshold 3.2.

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.
  # This leg runs the same
  # perf-tagged tests for trajectory-touching PRs and aggregates into
  # Quality gate below. `--tags perf` is precise: the only perf-tagged test
  # is the #262 gate (test/integration/trajectory/perf_open_gate_test.dart,
  # lands with #300), so the 97 MB fixture never runs for other PRs.
  perf-gate:
    name: Perf gate (trajectory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.perf == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test --tags perf
        run: dart test --tags perf

  # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
  # `model_request_summary` records and the session chain's record shape —
  # a shape change there breaks the fold even when every regular leg is
  # green, so this suite is a merge gate for trajectory/session/usage
  # diffs. Gate model (2026-09 dispatch-only CI): this workflow has NO
  # pull_request trigger — the SM dispatches it on the PR head, so
  # `github.event_name` is never 'pull_request' and a PR-only `if` would
  # leave this leg permanently skipped (REG-1 gating nothing). On real PR
  # events the path classifier narrows it to usage-relevant diffs; on every
  # other event (main/tags/schedule/release + SM validation dispatches)
  # the full gate runs, so the suite runs there too. Same latent bug still
  # pending for perf-gate (issue #303) — flagged in the gh-1243 rework.
  usage-fold:
    name: Usage fold (ledger chain)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      needs.changes.outputs.usagefold == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Usage-fold suite
        # The path classifier also gates on ^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$
        # — the CLI wiring test that exercises that file must run here too,
        # otherwise a wiring regression merges behind a green test/usage.
        run: dart test test/usage test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart

name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.

    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main

      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0239549Z # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0240493Z # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0241382Z # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242221Z # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254067Z # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0256564Z #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0258602Z #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0259401Z #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261101Z #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.
  # This leg runs the same
  # perf-tagged tests for trajectory-touching PRs and aggregates into
  # Quality gate below. `--tags perf` is precise: the only perf-tagged test
  # is the #262 gate (test/integration/trajectory/perf_open_gate_test.dart,
  # lands with #300), so the 97 MB fixture never runs for other PRs.
  perf-gate:
    name: Perf gate (trajectory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.perf == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test --tags perf
        run: dart test --tags perf

  # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
  # `model_request_summary` records and the session chain's record shape —
  # a shape change there breaks the fold even when every regular leg is
  # green, so this suite is a merge gate for trajectory/session/usage
  # diffs. Gate model (2026-09 dispatch-only CI): this workflow has NO
  # pull_request trigger — the SM dispatches it on the PR head, so
  # `github.event_name` is never 'pull_request' and a PR-only `if` would
  # leave this leg permanently skipped (REG-1 gating nothing). On real PR
  # events the path classifier narrows it to usage-relevant diffs; on every
  # other event (main/tags/schedule/release + SM validation dispatches)
  # the full gate runs, so the suite runs there too. Same latent bug still
  # pending for perf-gate (issue #303) — flagged in the gh-1243 rework.
  usage-fold:
    name: Usage fold (ledger chain)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      needs.changes.outputs.usagefold == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Usage-fold suite
        # The path classifier also gates on ^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$
        # — the CLI wiring test that exercises that file must run here too,
        # otherwise a wiring regression merges behind a green test/usage.
        run: dart test test/usage test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart

The quarantine mechanism only applies to `test/integration` legs, not core shards. Core shard 0/4 ran `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` directly.

Options for the fix:
1. **Fix the test's noise sensitivity** (raise base cells so the median is above the jitter floor). This is the actual root cause: at 100k cells the ASCII-batched path measures ~3.3ms — timer/scheduling noise on a loaded shared CI runner easily skews a 5-run median at that scale. Raising to e.g. 250k cells (≈8ms base) keeps total runtime similar and is the gh-1357-rule-compliant fix ("a bound the fix sits at is noise, not a gate").

2. Quarantine — not applicable (integration-only).

Let me check git history for this test and gh-1357 rule precedent. Also check whether the failure reproduced elsewhere. The ratio observed: 3.31ms @100k, 12.09ms @200k. If true behavior were linear ~3.3→6.6ms, 12.09 is way off — hmm, that suggests something more than jitter? But the same test passed CJK (which is slower per cell) and the 1M ASCII budget test passed in <100ms — meaning 1M ≈ ≤100ms vs 200k at 12ms — 5x size for ≤8x time is consistent-ish with linear + overhead. If 200k took 12.09 while 100k took 3.31, that IS suspicious of superlinearity... unless the 100k median was lucky-fast (JIT/branch/caches) or the 200k unlucky-slow. Given CJK passed (CJK at 100k does ~2x work per cell vs ASCII so times are larger, less noise-sensitive), and hard-cut passed, and the absolute 1M test passed — the batching is linear. It's jitter at small sizes.

Hmm wait, actually let me reconsider: maybe ASCII prose at 200k hits a different cache tier. Locally I can measure. Let me run the test locally a few times to see variance.

Also, per the PR rework rules (TDD): RED — reproduce. Locally reproducing CI jitter is hard, but I can demonstrate noise sensitivity by running the growth test repeatedly, or by measuring ratio variance at 100k vs a larger base. 2026-10-11T04:57:43.0239549Z # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0240493Z # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0241382Z # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242221Z # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254067Z # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0256564Z #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0257384Z #     swapped in the first cut, re-enshrining the starvation);
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0258602Z #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0259401Z #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261101Z #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261930Z #     a red Windows build must not hold the pure-Dart publish
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0262882Z #     hostage (the v1.0.519-521 starvation).

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

The growth-shape asserts use median of 5 runs at 100k base. For the fastest path (ASCII batching), 3.3ms median is at the noise floor; CI runner jitter makes the ratio unreliable. # SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the

  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.

  # lands with #300), so the 97 MB fixture never runs for other PRs.
  perf-gate:
    name: Perf gate (trajectory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.perf == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test --tags perf
        run: dart test --tags perf

  # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
  # `model_request_summary` records and the session chain's record shape —
  # a shape change there breaks the fold even when every regular leg is
  # green, so this suite is a merge gate for trajectory/session/usage
  # diffs. Gate model (2026-09 dispatch-only CI): this workflow has NO
  # pull_request trigger — the SM dispatches it on the PR head, so
  # `github.event_name` is never 'pull_request' and a PR-only `if` would
  # leave this leg permanently skipped (REG-1 gating nothing). On real PR
  # events the path classifier narrows it to usage-relevant diffs; on every
  # other event (main/tags/schedule/release + SM validation dispatches)
  # the full gate runs, so the suite runs there too. Same latent bug still
  # pending for perf-gate (issue #303) — flagged in the gh-1243 rework.
  usage-fold:
    name: Usage fold (ledger chain)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      needs.changes.outputs.usagefold == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Usage-fold suite
        # The path classifier also gates on ^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$
        # — the CLI wiring test that exercises that file must run here too,
        # otherwise a wiring regression merges behind a green test/usage.
        run: dart test test/usage test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.
  # This leg runs the same
  # perf-tagged tests for trajectory-touching PRs and aggregates into
  # Quality gate below. `--tags perf` is precise: the only perf-tagged test
  # is the #262 gate (test/integration/trajectory/perf_open_gate_test.dart,
  # lands with #300), so the 97 MB fixture never runs for other PRs.
  perf-gate:
    name: Perf gate (trajectory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.perf == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test --tags perf
        run: dart test --tags perf

  # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
  # `model_request_summary` records and the session chain's record shape —
  # a shape change there breaks the fold even when every regular leg is
  # green, so this suite is a merge gate for trajectory/session/usage
  # diffs. Gate model (2026-09 dispatch-only CI): this workflow has NO
  # pull_request trigger — the SM dispatches it on the PR head, so
  # `github.event_name` is never 'pull_request' and a PR-only `if` would
  # leave this leg permanently skipped (REG-1 gating nothing). On real PR
  # events the path classifier narrows it to usage-relevant diffs; on every
  # other event (main/tags/schedule/release + SM validation dispatches)
  # the full gate runs, so the suite runs there too. Same latent bug still
  # pending for perf-gate (issue #303) — flagged in the gh-1243 rework.
  usage-fold:
    name: Usage fold (ledger chain)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      needs.changes.outputs.usagefold == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Usage-fold suite
        # The path classifier also gates on ^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$
        # — the CLI wiring test that exercises that file must run here too,
        # otherwise a wiring regression merges behind a green test/usage.
        run: dart test test/usage test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0239549Z # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0240493Z # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0241382Z # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242221Z # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0258602Z #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0259401Z #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261101Z #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

          echo "Quality gate OK"

  # Issue #303 (the #262 DoD): the perf-tagged e2e gate must red-block the
  # MERGE, not only the release — before #551 the only integration leg
  # outside PRs was tag-time, and perf stays excluded from integration-mock.
  # This leg runs the same
  # perf-tagged tests for trajectory-touching PRs and aggregates into
  # Quality gate below. `--tags perf` is precise: the only perf-tagged test
  # is the #262 gate (test/integration/trajectory/perf_open_gate_test.dart,
  # lands with #300), so the 97 MB fixture never runs for other PRs.
  perf-gate:
    name: Perf gate (trajectory)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.perf == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test --tags perf
        run: dart test --tags perf

  # gh-1241 REG-1: the usage fold consumes the trajectory ledger's
  # `model_request_summary` records and the session chain's record shape —
  # a shape change there breaks the fold even when every regular leg is
  # green, so this suite is a merge gate for trajectory/session/usage
  # diffs. Gate model (2026-09 dispatch-only CI): this workflow has NO
  # pull_request trigger — the SM dispatches it on the PR head, so
  # `github.event_name` is never 'pull_request' and a PR-only `if` would
  # leave this leg permanently skipped (REG-1 gating nothing). On real PR
  # events the path classifier narrows it to usage-relevant diffs; on every
  # other event (main/tags/schedule/release + SM validation dispatches)
  # the full gate runs, so the suite runs there too. Same latent bug still
  # pending for perf-gate (issue #303) — flagged in the gh-1243 rework.
  usage-fold:
    name: Usage fold (ledger chain)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: changes
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
      needs.changes.outputs.usagefold == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Usage-fold suite
        # The path classifier also gates on ^lib/src/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger\.dart$
        # — the CLI wiring test that exercises that file must run here too,
        # otherwise a wiring regression merges behind a green test/usage.
        run: dart test test/usage test/cli/agent_cli_usage_ledger_test.dart

Options for the fix:
1. **Fix the test's noise sensitivity** (raise base cells so the median is above the jitter floor). This is the actual root cause: at 100k cells the ASCII-batched path measures ~3.3ms — timer/scheduling noise on a loaded shared CI runner easily skews a 5-run median at that scale. Raising to e.g. 250k cells (≈8ms base) keeps total runtime similar and is the gh-1357-rule-compliant fix ("a bound the fix sits at is noise, not a gate").

Let me check git history for this test and gh-1357 rule precedent. Also check whether the failure reproduced elsewhere. The ratio observed: 3.31ms @100k, 12.09ms @200k. If true behavior were linear ~3.3→6.6ms, 12.09 is way off — hmm, that suggests something more than jitter? But the same test passed CJK (which is slower per cell) and the 1M ASCII budget test passed in <100ms — meaning 1M ≈ ≤100ms vs 200k at 12ms — 5x size for ≤8x time is consistent-ish with linear + overhead. If 200k took 12.09 while 100k took 3.31, that IS suspicious of superlinearity... unless the 100k median was lucky-fast (JIT/branch/caches) or the 200k unlucky-slow. Given CJK passed (CJK at 100k does ~2x work per cell vs ASCII so times are larger, less noise-sensitive), and hard-cut passed, and the absolute 1M test passed — the batching is linear. 2026-10-11T04:57:43.0239549Z # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0240493Z # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0241382Z # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242221Z # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254067Z # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0256564Z #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0257384Z #     swapped in the first cut, re-enshrining the starvation);
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0258602Z #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0259401Z #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261101Z #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261930Z #     a red Windows build must not hold the pure-Dart publish
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0262882Z #     hostage (the v1.0.519-521 starvation).

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0239549Z # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0240493Z # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0241382Z # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242221Z # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254067Z # #1368 — two independent verdicts over the needs legs:
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0256564Z #     gate the publish (review thread: the case bodies were
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0257384Z #     swapped in the first cut, re-enshrining the starvation);
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0258602Z #   PLATFORM/NATIVE/PTY legs (build-web/android/ios/macos,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0259401Z #     fa-aot-build, installer-verify, install-pin-gate,
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261101Z #     only: they redden the required aggregate but NEVER dart_ok —
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0261930Z #     a red Windows build must not hold the pure-Dart publish
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0262882Z #     hostage (the v1.0.519-521 starvation).

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'

blocks.text:
Even with 4 load generators saturating all cores, medians stayed healthy. CI's failure had small=3.31ms (fast!) and doubled=12.09ms — i.e., the DOUBLED measurement got the jitter, not the small one. Median of 5 at 200k took 12ms when quiet machines take ~6.7-7ms. That means jitter can inflate a single median by ~1.8x. To trip 3.2 from a baseline ~2.0 you need ~1.6x inflation — plausible on a noisy shared runner (GitHub ubuntu runners are known to be very jittery, with steal time).

I can't easily reproduce the exact flake on this quiet machine, but the mechanism is clear and the fix is well-grounded: the gh-1357 rule stated in the file itself says bounds need "generous headroom over local medians (CI runners jitter; a bound the fix sits at is noise, not a gate)". The growth tests sit at 100k cells where the ASCII-batched path runs ~3.3ms — with a median of only 5 samples, a noisy-neighbor pause lands squarely in the median when the whole measurement window is that short. The CI failure shows exactly this: small=3.31ms was fine but doubled=12.09ms inflated ~1.8x.

The fix: raise the growth-test base size so the timed window is well above the noise floor. E.g., base 250k → small ~8-9ms, doubled ~17-18ms. Also consider increasing runs (median of 5 → 7) for robustness. But keep runtime bounded — the whole file currently takes seconds; 250k costs ~25ms per test pair, trivial.

Wait — but does raising base actually help? Jitter is proportional-ish: a scheduling pause of ~5ms hits an 8ms measurement as hard as it hits a 3ms one. The real robustness lever is the median of more runs plus a longer window. Alternative approach used commonly: measure more runs and take median, or repeat the growth measurement a few times and take the best/minimum ratio (min is robust against inflation jitter since jitter only ever inflates).

Actually a cleaner standard technique for perf gates on noisy CI: take the MINIMUM across runs (min is the statistic robust to positive-only noise like scheduling pauses). Median of 5 can still catch a pause in the middle. Min-of-7 makes inflation flake practically impossible while still catching true superlinearity (which inflates BOTH measurements proportionally — true superlinear work is not noise; ratio of mins still ~4x for quadratic).

But careful about "true ratio" — with min statistics, small could be measured on the fastest possible cache state and doubled on... min over enough runs converges to the true compute time. A genuinely quadratic implementation would still show ~4x ratio with mins. That's the robust fix.

However, changing median→min changes the helper used by the absolute-budget tests too. I could keep median for absolute budgets (they have generous headroom: post-fix median 33ms vs 100ms budget) and use min-of-N for the growth-shape ratios. Or simpler: increase runs for growth tests.

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0242912Z dart_blocker=""
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0243538Z # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0244390Z # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245156Z # through with zero gates executed.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0245969Z [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0246898Z # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0247987Z # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0248779Z # not a pass — review follow-up, #796/#801.
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0249431Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0250385Z   [ "$R_SUPPLY_CHAIN" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="supply-chain = $R_SUPPLY_CHAIN (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251315Z fi
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0251757Z if [ -z "$dart_blocker" ]; then
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0252655Z   [ "$R_DEP_AUDIT" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="dep-audit = $R_DEP_AUDIT (skipped security is a dodge)"
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0253535Z fi

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0254892Z #   PACKAGE legs (everything NOT platform) → dart_blocker: they
2026-10-11T04:57:43.0255749Z #     gate dart_ok AND the aggregate — analyze/test/coverage must

2026-10-11T04:57:43.0260232Z #     cube-kernel-live, cli-visual-settings, pty-*) → platform_red

# SM kicker — thin stub over the canonical watchdog in the factory home.
# All logic (sm-liveness + head-completeness) lives in
# IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml;
# defaults below match this repo (ci.yml, three required contexts).
name: SM kicker

run-name: '🥁 kicker ${{ github.event_name }} ${{ github.ref_name }}'

on:
  push:
    branches-ignore: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '13,43 * * * *'
  # Event-driven wake-up (2026-10-03, parity with dmtools-dart#338):
  # GitHub starved both crons (machine-sm */10 + kicker 13,43) for 100
  # minutes on dmtools-dart; a green validation verdict sat unlatched the
  # whole window. CI conclusions are the verdict moments — react to them
  # and latching/FIFO-arming happen within seconds, cron or no cron.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  checks: read

jobs:
  kicker:
    # Tracks dmtools-agentic-workflows @main — always-latest policy (owner
    # directive 2026-10-04): kicker fixes (real ticks awf#13, per-head-SHA
    # concurrency awf#14) go live on merge, no re-pin ceremony; the
    # concurrency scoping lives in the reusable workflow. Guarded by
    # test/machine_kit/factory_stub_ref_test.dart.
    #
    # KNOWN UPSTREAM DEFECT (awf#15, live on awf@main as of 2026-10-04):
    # the head-completeness job's `gh api` calls put `--jq` BEFORE
    # `--arg`/`--argjson`, so gh eats the flag as the --jq value and the
    # rest become positional args — `accepts 1 arg(s), received 4`, exit 1.
    # Trigger shape: a CODELESS branch head (2 parents, 0 changed files —
    # a routine branch-sync merge with no content diff). Code-bearing
    # heads skip before the broken lines, so only zero-diff merge heads
    # crash the job — and they crash it even when CI is fully green (the
    # crash precedes the required-contexts check), so the job's own
    # rescue dispatch can never heal the exact heads it exists for.
    # Resolution until the upstream fix lands: keep the branch head
    # CODE-BEARING — the next real commit re-enables the healthy
    # code-bearing-head skip. Diagnosed 2026-10-04 on run 37193754301
    # (head 1fe9b1232, a zero-diff sync merge).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm-kicker.yml@main
    with:
      sm_workflow: machine-sm.yml
      ci_workflow: ci.yml
      ci_display_name: CI
      required_contexts: 'Quality gate,JS engine integration (quickjs-ng),Binaries smoke gate'
